name: Kahara Tomoyuki
source: Wanted to live alone, he moved to his grandmother's house in rural area as an exchange with his grandmother. He transferred to Izumigamori Academy as a second year and reunited with his childhood friend [url=/c3269]Megumi[/url] who he had not see in three years. Though he had intended to enjoy his freedom of living alone, his [url=/c14359]younger sister[/url] and [url=/c26204]another resident[/url] also moved in to his place after sometime.
